mediaWork.title: Brian Banks
mediaWork.publisherOrNetwork: ShivHans Pictures, Gidden Media (Distributed by Bleecker Street)
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The true story of Brian Banks, a promising high school football player whose life was upended by a wrongful conviction for rape, and his long fight for exoneration with the help of the California Innocence Project.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: An All-American football star's dreams to play in the NFL are halted when he is falsely accused of rape and sent to prison. Years later, he fights to clear his name within an unjust system.

mediaItems.focusOrTheme: The true story of Brian Banks, a promising high school football player whose life was upended by a wrongful conviction for rape, and his long fight for exoneration with the help of the California Innocence Project.
mediaItems.summaryNotes: The film depicts the initial accusation against Brian Banks, his decision to take a plea deal, his struggles during incarceration and parole, the accuser's recantation, the legal battle led by the California Innocence Project, and his eventual exoneration and attempt to reclaim his life.

featuredIndividuals.narrativeSummary: Brian Banks was wrongfully convicted of kidnapping and rape in 2002 and exonerated in 2012. He served over 5 years in prison and 5 years on parole. His conviction was overturned due to a false accusation and pressure to accept a plea deal.
